items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: now I got to really play with… Stretch Powell was there. He was there on percussion on that show. Marty Grupt was also there.

ctx.x: Yeah, CBS. So he recommended me and I came really late and accepted

it. He didn‟t know me when I came in and I got that job with this thing. [Unintelligible] was a contractor and there was another bass player, I forgot what the name is, that didn‟t seem to be quite up to par with some of the academic things but he had been there a long time and there was no reason to let him go. So he was on staff there but for the heavy things they needed Arco, and big band things, and some little instant creativity. Percy Faith was very much into… he had the Woolworth‟s Hour on Sunday and this…
